timing_scope: The existing outer _timer includes flock acquisition wait. Those original phase totals are not pure compute time and cannot alone establish DTPO/PPO kernel efficiency.
human_decision: Four resident jobs required. Checkpoint-boundary rotation rejected. Solve actual memory capacity first; AppWorld DTPO has NOT been resubmitted.
memory_followup: Actual native DT post-B4 reserve reclaim demonstrates late cache lifetime. Earlier release at true last consumers is under source investigation, not deployed or validated. Existing original three training processes preserved.
